Before King Charles's Caribbean tour, Buckingham Palace said the he would not shy away from the impact of the slave trade but, in line with the UK government position, would not apologise for Britain's role in the slave trade or offer reparations.

articles.title: Trump says he has 'concepts of a very good deal' with Canada
articles.titleZh: 特朗普表示，他与加拿大有“非常好的交易概念”
articles.summary: President Donald Trump on Sunday said he spoke with Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney and said the two leaders agreed to a “concept of a very good deal” to end the ongoing US-Canada trade stalemate. Trump claimed that Canada will build and pay for the long-stalled Keystone XL Pipeline project.
articles.summaryZh: 直接播放媒体官方频道发布的新闻视频，保留记者原声、现场声音及原始语速。
articles.sourceNote: Official publisher video · original English audio
articles.readingText:
President Donald Trump on Sunday said he spoke with Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney and said the two leaders agreed to a “concept of a very good deal” to end the ongoing US-Canada trade stalemate.

Trump claimed that Canada will build and pay for the long-stalled Keystone XL Pipeline project.
articles.readingTextZh:
唐纳德特朗普总统周日表示，他与加拿大总理马克卡尼进行了交谈，并表示两位领导人同意“非常好的协议概念” ，以结束正在进行的美加贸易僵局。

特朗普声称，加拿大将建造并支付长期停滞的Keystone XL管道项目。

articles.title: Federal judge throws out Trump DOJ's Alaska Senate lawsuit
articles.titleZh: 联邦法官驳回特朗普在阿拉斯加州参议院的诉讼
articles.summary:
A federal judge on Sunday threw out the Justice Department’s lawsuit seeking to segregate ballots and delay certification of Alaska’s Senate race, the latest legal rebuke to a rash of Trump administration attempts to meddle in the 2026 midterms. 

US District Judge Sharon Gleason said the federal government doesn’t have the standing to force Alaska to segregate ballots and that such a move would violate the right of voters to cast a secret ballot. Regardless, she added, it’s too late for the courts to force such a major change on the eve of an election. 

CNN's Gabe Cohen has the details and CNN's Kyung Lah reports from an Anchorage, Alaska, polling place.

1:25 CNN's Gabe Cohen shares details of the judge's ruling
